A fully-featured Operating System or platform that provides voice and data communications capabilities, enables personalization of the device by the user and in addition supports installation and maintenance of mobile applications e.g., downloadable from an Application store. (bm) “SMS” means a message which is sent through short message service and includes a Multi- Media message which is sent through Multi-Media message service (MMS); (bn) “Subscriber” means a person or legal entity who subscribes to a telecom service provided by an Access Provider; (bo) “Telecom resources” means any telegraph used to send voice call or messages; (bp) “Telemarketer” means a person or legal entity engaged in the activity of transmission or delivery of commercial communication or scrubbing or aggregation.
